source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The zero rectangle is the destination; the non-background colored
    # rectangle is the source pattern.
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not zero_cells:
        return out
    zr0 = min(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    zr1 = max(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    zc0 = min(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    zc1 = max(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0}
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda color: sum(cell == color for row in grid for cell in row))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, bg)]
    sr0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    sr1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    sc0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    sc1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    if sr1 - sr0 != zr1 - zr0 or sc1 - sc0 != zc1 - zc0:
        return out
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            out[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = grid[sr0 + dr][sc1 - dc]
    return out
'''
